info.name: BCMS Pro — Full API (generated)
info.description:
Auto-generated from `php artisan route:list --path=api`.

1. Set collection variable **base_url** (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8000`).
2. Run **00 Authentication / Login (staff Sanctum)** — token is stored in **token**.
3. Call **01 Authenticated** requests (folder-level Bearer).

item.name: 00 Authentication
item.description: Call **Auth / Login (staff Sanctum)** first. On success, `data.token` is saved to the collection variable `token`. Other folders use Bearer {{token}}.

exec: console.log('Saved token to collection (and environment if active)');
console.log('Login response had no data.token; body:', JSON.stringify(json));

request.description: Returns session-style payload; does not issue the same Sanctum `data.token` as staff login.

item.name: Bridge app authentication (mobile OTP) — may save token

exec: console.log('Saved mobile flow token to collection variable token');

request.description: Portal/mobile flow using `User` model. Token appears in `data.token` only after successful OTP verification.

item.name: 02 Public / no Sanctum (no Bearer)
item.description: These routes do not list `auth:sanctum` in `route:list`. They use **noauth**; adjust if your deployment adds middleware.
